units: <cite ref="Eruvin 54a:5">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> (fr. Ben Sira) <he>שאין בש׳ תענוג וכ׳</he> for there is no pleasure in the grave, and death knows no tarrying.

<cite ref="Eruvin 54a">Ib.</cite> <he>ואם תאמר … בש׳ מי יודה לך</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>יגיד</he>) and if you will say, I will leave my children a settlement: who will thank thee for it in the grave? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 1:6:2">Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="D00556"><he>דְּיֵיטָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 261">Yalk. Is. 261</cite> <he>ואם … שנפל עד ש׳ וכ׳</he> and when he (the Lord) sees a man fallen even to the grave, he raises him up (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 113:7">Ps. CXIII, 7</cite> <he>מקימי מעפר</he>).
<cite ref="Sotah 10b:14">Sot. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>נבקע ש׳ מתחתיו</he> the deep burst open under him (Absalom).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:22">Ab. IV, 22</cite> <he>ואל … שהש׳ בית מנוס לך</he> let not thy passion reassure thee that the grave is a house of refuge (from responsibility) to thee; a. fr.
